text_block_list.text:
Just before heading to the summer training 
camp—

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Commanding the lead!! Cesario enters the 
final straight out in front!"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Cesario takes the lead and pulls even 
further away from the pack! Maintaining a 
three-length lead, she crosses under 200 
meters to go!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wah... wah...!

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"It's Cesario, Cesario!! There's no way 
Cesario loses this now! A lead of four, 
five lengths!!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Cesario, go...! Keep going just like 
that—!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text: "...Cesaarrriioooo!! Cesario did it!!"

text_block_list.name: Heart & Craft
text_block_list.text: I did it...!! Unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The winning time is 1 minute 59.03 
seconds! Without slowing down a bit, she 
crosses the finish line in a solo 
runaway!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Japan's Tiara Umamusume, Cesario!! For 
the first time in history, a Japanese 
Umamusume has conquered the American 
Oaks!!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Amazing...!! Incredible, Cesario...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"To truly cross the sea and display such 
overwhelming strength..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Truly— a 'Japanese superstar'..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Th-The phone! A congratulatory 
call!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Come autumn, I'll have to fight against 
a monster like that, huh.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, this gets me fired up! Ah, won't she 
hurry back already...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It "fires you up"... you say? ...Even 
after seeing that kind of strength?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
After seeing such terrifying power— how 
can you... possibly think that?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...No, it's only natural to think so. 
With the kind of strength shown at the NHK 
Mile Cup..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—The Shuka Sho is the last one. My final 
chance to make up for Mother's regrets...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I must win. I must prove myself. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I'm scared...——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Phew... It's crazy hot!
choice_data_list:
Is it totally different from summers in 
America after all?

Is it totally different from summers in 
America after all?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You could say yes, and you could say no. 
America is just that big, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Where I grew up, it gets this hot and 
humid in the summer too."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Unpredictable weather, sudden storms... It 
was quite a harsh place... Ah, nostalgia.

Daring Heart's mental fortitude might have 
something to do with growing up in such a 
tough environment.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, so... Japanese summers are no 
problem! Train me relentlessly, please!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...You saw it too, didn't you? Cesario's 
historic victory.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Craft isn't the only rival. In the Shuka 
Sho... Messiah, and Cesario... those two 
are likely to be major threats as well."
choice_data_list:
(But... that's not the only wall standing 
in the way.)

text_block_list.text:
Her formidable rivals are certainly a 
threat. But for Daring Heart, there is one 
more factor we have to consider—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Distance aptitude.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"The Shuka Sho is a middle-distance race, 
but my best distance is probably a mile... 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's my own body, after all. I had a 
hunch, but... It really is true, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Against monster-class rivals, at an 
unsuitable distance... How can I possibly 
win?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: What are your thoughts?

"For an Umamusume, distance aptitudes are 
largely determined by body structure... 
Rather than trying to overcome it, honing 
one's strengths would be more effective. 
In other words—"
choice_data_list: Gain an edge to surpass your rivals

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Craft's speed, Cesario's finishing kick, 
Messiah's tenacity..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I will find my own weapon that surpasses 
all of them."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—During this summer training camp. I can 
do it! I'll show them...!"
choice_data_list: Don't forget to take breaks too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: In that case, don't worry! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!! —Trainer, prepare yourself!

The next moment, water splashed all over 
my face!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"It's seawater, after all! Trainer, don't 
hold back, come at me with everything 
you've got☆"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Stay focused! Don't space out on me. 
Summer has already begun!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Both training and relaxing—let's go all 
out! Let's make it a passionate summer 
camp♪
